Card Q&A.q: Can the Digimon that digivolves into a Digimon card in my hand for this card's [On Play] [Main] effect be a Digimon other than the top card placed as the bottom digivolution card?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or fewer memory, set it to 3.

[On Play] [Main] By suspending this Tamer and placing the top card of one of your [Light Fang] or [Night claw] trait Digimon as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
